skill.name: expo-api-audit
skill.description: Audits Expo and React Native API integration for generated hooks, auth token handling, direct API calls, offline behavior, and backend sync gaps.
skill.summary: Audit Expo API usage, auth flows, generated clients, and offline sync behavior.
skill.author: CJHarmath

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, and literal search patterns. The skill shows no prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden network destination evidence. Two contextual risks remain: optional package installation instructions and an Orval dry-run command that may execute project configuration.

remediation.issue: Orval dry-run may execute project configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running npx orval, and suggest reviewing the Orval config first.

remediation.issue: Dependency section recommends global package installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Make installs optional, prefer existing project tools, and require user confirmation before brew, apt-get, cargo, or npm global installs.

remediation.issue: Shell examples inspect local configuration and source files.
remediation.suggestion: State that commands run only in the target repository and may reveal local configuration to the agent.

content.value_statement: Expo apps often hide broken API flows, unsafe token handling, and stale screen data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a structured API audit.
actual_capabilities: Maps Orval config, generated hooks, Axios clients, token managers, stores, Expo config, and screens.
Reviews auth token storage, refresh flow, interceptors, 401 handling, and logout behavior.
Finds direct fetch or Axios calls that bypass generated API hooks.
Flags hardcoded URLs, process.env usage, mock screen data, and frontend-only persistence.
Checks React Query offline modes, cache persistence, reconnect behavior, and error boundaries.
Produces prioritized audit findings with affected files, impact, and recommended fixes.
limitations: Requires repository access and shell commands to inspect local project files.
Does not run emulator, device, or end-to-end mobile tests by itself.
Orval and package manager commands may require explicit user confirmation.
Findings should be checked against backend contracts and product requirements.

use_cases.title: Pre-release API Review
use_cases.description: Audit an Expo app before release to catch broken backend sync, hardcoded data, and missing error handling.

use_cases.title: Auth Flow Hardening
use_cases.description: Check token storage, refresh behavior, interceptors, and logout paths for Expo security issues.

use_cases.title: Generated Client Cleanup
use_cases.description: Find screens and services that bypass Orval hooks or duplicate server state in local stores.

prompt_templates.title: Basic API Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of API usage patterns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Expo app API integration. Focus on generated hooks, direct API calls, and hardcoded screen data.

prompt_templates.title: Auth Token Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review auth token handling in my Expo app. Check storage, refresh flow, interceptors, and logout behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Offline Sync Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate audit of cache and offline behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit offline behavior for React Query and Expo networking. Check cached reads, failed mutations, reconnect behavior, and error states.

prompt_templates.title: Full Integration Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full Expo API integration audit. Return prioritized findings with affected files, severity, impact, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Audit auth storage and refresh behavior.
output: Critical: Tokens are stored in AsyncStorage instead of expo-secure-store.
Major: Refresh calls can run in parallel during 401 retries.
Fix: Move tokens to SecureStore and add refresh deduplication.

output_examples.input: Find screens that bypass generated hooks.
output_examples.output: The report lists screens using direct API calls, explains each bypass, and recommends generated hook replacements.

output_examples.input: Check offline behavior for user profile updates.
output_examples.output: The audit identifies missing queue handling, unclear offline errors, and stale cache behavior after reconnect.

best_practices: Run the audit from the repository root so file discovery stays scoped.
Confirm before executing package manager commands or project code generators.
Review high-severity auth findings before lower-priority cleanup items.
anti_patterns: Do not run global installs without explicit user approval.
Do not treat every direct API call as wrong without checking its purpose.
Do not paste secret values into the audit report.

faq.question: Does this skill support Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for repository-based Expo audits.

faq.question: Does it replace mobile testing?
faq.answer: No. It reviews code patterns and reports risks, but emulator and device tests remain necessary.

faq.question: Can it audit auth security?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks token storage, refresh logic, request interceptors, 401 handling, and logout behavior.

faq.question: Does it require Orval?
faq.answer: No. It includes Orval checks, but many API, auth, and offline checks apply without Orval.

faq.question: Will it read environment secrets?
faq.answer: It searches for unsafe environment usage. Users should avoid sharing secret values in outputs.

faq.question: What output can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce a Markdown report, prioritized findings, fix tasks, or pull request guidance.
